expert_term.local: tiesu eksperts (valsts tiesu eksperts; valsts atzīts privātais tiesu eksperts)
expert_term.en: court expert certified by the Council of Court Experts and entered in the Register of Court Experts

appointment.summary_en: The decision to order an expert examination is taken by the person directing the proceedings (procesa virzītājs); the examination is ordered to establish facts and circumstances relevant to the criminal proceedings, on which the expert gives an opinion.

rights_duties.summary_en: Liability of court experts is governed by Chapter V of the Law on Court Experts. The Council of Court Experts opens disciplinary proceedings for non-compliance with rules on expert activity, failure to perform professional duties, gross negligence, abuse of office, improper conduct or breach of ethics, loss of or wilful damage to objects submitted, and disclosure of information obtained in the examination.

appointment.summary_en: In civil proceedings the court orders an expert examination at the request of the parties; it is carried out by persons specified in the Law on Court Experts. The parties choose the expert by agreement; failing agreement within the court's time limit, the court chooses. Several experts may be appointed.

questions.summary_en: The opinion must give reasoned answers to the questions put by the court. If during the examination the expert finds circumstances relevant to the case on which no questions were put, the expert may point them out in the opinion.

items_en: precise description of the examinations carried out
reasoned answers to the questions put by the court
optionally, relevant circumstances found on which no questions were put
signature of all experts for a joint opinion; separate opinions where experts disagree
items_local: motivētas atbildes uz tiesas uzdotajiem jautājumiem
norāde uz apstākļiem, kuriem ir nozīme lietā un par kuriem jautājumi nav uzdoti
kopīgu atzinumu paraksta visi eksperti; ja domas nesaskan, katrs eksperts raksta atsevišķu atzinumu

rights_duties.basis: Civilprocesa likums; Tiesu ekspertu likums (sections not verified)
rights_duties.summary_en: The opinion must be reasoned and substantiated; the expert gives an objective opinion in his or her own name and is personally responsible for it. The expert must appear when summoned. The court assesses the opinion by inner conviction; it has no predetermined force.

statute.title_en: Law on Court Experts (certification by the Council of Court Experts, certificate valid five years, public register at eksperti.ta.gov.lv)

liability.norm: Krimināllikums 300. pants (as given in the task brief; not verified); Tiesu ekspertu likums V nodaļa (disciplinary liability)
liability.summary_en: Criminal liability for a knowingly false expert opinion and unjustified refusal exists under the Criminal Law; the exact section, elements and maximum penalty were not verified.
liability.warning_local: Tiesu eksperts, saņemot tiesu eksperta sertifikātu, ar parakstu apliecina, ka ir brīdināts, ka par nepamatotu atteikšanos veikt ekspertīzi vai apzināti nepatiesa tiesu eksperta atzinuma sniegšanu ir saucams pie atbildības saskaņā ar Krimināllikumu.
liability.warning_en: On receiving the court expert certificate, the court expert confirms by signature that he or she has been warned that an unjustified refusal to carry out an expert examination or the giving of a knowingly false court expert opinion entails liability under the Criminal Law.

esignature.law_en: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183; national implementing act not verified
